title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a fire‑filled Rochester show with a standout Brokedown encore.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean, clear and crisp soundboard mix, delivering an excellent listening experience despite not fully conveying the live energy. Fans describe the performance as "on fire" from the start, noting the roof‑tearing vibe of the night and highlighting the sweet Brokedown encore as a memorable moment.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviewers gave 4–5 stars, emphasizing superb audio clarity and high‑energy performance; only one anomalous zero‑star rating appears, so the overall weighted impression is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the board "crispy", "clean" and "clear" with no mention of dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show opened with an early soundcheck that the crowd heard, maintaining high momentum throughout; reviewers note a consistently "on fire" vibe and a powerful encore.
